data.body: Implemented canonical bridge diagnostics migration for the remaining reconcile-check observables. Added fsck compatibility buckets for orphaned bindings/Jira and unbound locals, surfaced persisted reconcile-check summaries through bridge_status (including relocated store coverage), and updated the MCP bridge-status output model/schema mirror for the new reconcile_diagnostics field. Validation: targeted fsck/status/schema/MCP suites passed; make lint and make typecheck passed; pytest -m 'not integration and not external' now fails only on the pre-existing baseline test_atomic_completion_close::test_relevant_remote_rejection_never_places_candidate_on_shared_head, which reproduces on clean origin/main.
